candidates.snippet: Umar ibn al-Khattab is consistently described across 9 model source lists as influential for: Second Caliph who oversaw the rapid expansion of the Islamic empire and established its administrative and legal foundations; Expanded Islamic Caliphate, established administrative systems for Islamic civilization; Expanded Islamic Caliphate enormously; established administrative systems; shaped Islamic governance; Expanded Islamic caliphate across Middle East and North Africa; As second caliph, expanded the Islamic state from Arabia to Persia and Egypt, establishing administrative systems that shaped Islamic governance for centuries; Second Caliph, expanded Islamic empire across Middle East and North Africa; Expanded Islamic Caliphate, established administrative systems; Second Caliph who oversaw the massive expansion of the early Islamic Empire.
